fields.Synopsis: Will Lock Academy, detective school in Paris, become THE new spot for the most dangerous criminals?!  It seems so: its founder, the great Professor Lock, has decided to sell his academy to his worst enemy, the criminal Jim Key! He is to the Professor Lock what Moriarty is to Sherlock Holmes: a brilliant adversary with diabolical plans!  For the students, the hour for a revolt at Lock Academy has rung! Dear adventurous detectives, your mission will be to discover what this dangerous sale is hiding for the sake of the world and prevent it from happening.  In 60 minutes, this investigation worthy of Back to the Future, will transport you through different ages between retro 70s and the future, with incredible special effects! With your team of 2 players minimum and 6 players maximum, embark on a unique mind-blowing adventure!

fields.Commentary: Started very strong and the wheels came off in the second half.

fields.Synopsis:
Ready to challenge the limits of time and explore a lost world? We present you a unique offer that you will not be able to resist! In partnership with Kirby Enterprises, experts in exotic travel, we offer you the unique opportunity to delve into the mysterious and abandoned Jurassic theme park, ancient home to amazing prehistoric creatures.

Our team of experienced guides will take you through the ruined facilities of what was once the most amazing park in the world. You will discover remains of attractions, you will walk through lush vegetation and you will hear the distant echoes of ancestral roars. Jurassic is more than a simple experience; it is an immersion in a living and real environment, where you will feel that you have traveled back in time.

As the founder of the park would say, "he has not noticed expenses," and this experience will not leave them indifferent. Get ready for a trip like no other, where excitement and tension will keep you on the edge of your seat at all times. Call now to reserve your place on this exciting journey!

Beneath Paris there is the City of Martyrs, an underground city full of secrets. It is in the heart of this city that Adèle, the governor's daughter has mysteriously disappeared.

Seen a few days ago in the company of Martin Joly, better known as the taxidermist, no one has heard from her anymore, she has disappeared. The governor promises a reward to those who find his daughter.

Enter Londium! Test your wits and teamwork skills. Will you be able to solve the mystery? Will they be able to find out what's going on in Londium? Will they have the cunning to help save the city? Can they withstand the pressure of the streets of Londium? Come play with your group of friends and enjy the experience of solving the mystery of Londium.

For centuries, the galaxy has been under the control of the Consortium. You are among the rebels and today, you have a chance to destroy the Consortium forever. You have 75 minutes to find an old military base and use its ionic cannon to take down the Consortium flagship.

There are rumors that in a shady antique shop there is a magical arcade machine called Zoltar Speaks. This machine was enchanted many centuries ago by a market merchant, Zoltar, and it has been waiting for centuries for your help, the chosen ones. Can you avoid the antique dealer and unravel the secrets of the antique shop to open the door to the 15th century? In a world of poverty and oppressed market traders, an important mission awaits! With the right strategy, you can outrun the Askari and defeat the greedy Sultan…
